$comment: Shared boss/capstone rubric fixtures. lib/gamification/bosses.test.ts derives `defeated` with isDefeated() and supabase/tests/bosses.test.sql inserts the same rows and reads (llm_evaluation->>'defeated')::boolean; both must equal the `defeated` value here. Thresholds: mission overall >= 70 and every dimension >= 40; weekly overall >= 75 and every dimension >= 50; capstone overall >= 75 and at least 9 of 12 dimensions >= 60. `overall` inside each rubric is the rounded mean of its dimensions, as lib/llm stores it.

strengths: Named the trigger recursion as the suspect
gaps: Did not weigh the async alternative
rubric.feedback: Solid diagnosis; the trade-off section was thin.

misconceptions.summary: Treated Queueable as having no limits of its own

strengths: Correctly asked for the debug log with the limit usage lines
gaps: No discussion of what the fix costs at 10M rows
rubric.feedback: Strong diagnosis, but the trade-off dimension fails the weekly bar.

strengths: Scalable data model with skew called out
rubric.feedback: Passes on eleven of twelve dimensions.
